name: AXM Sandbox
notes: The original Session-1 portable-project surface remains. A separate TEST disposable-candidate service can materialize one exact deterministic game packet, statically validate it without execution, create immutable repair iterations, emit inactive privacy-safe lesson candidates, and serve fixed bytes through a loopback review iframe. It launches no candidate process and grants no install, integration, library-admission, promotion, or CANON authority. No entities, clock, renderer, or general executor are claimed.
actions: list and validate Sandbox project folders
create one explicitly named portable project folder
inspect files inside the Sandbox projects boundary
materialize one byte-bound detached game candidate
create a statically valid immutable repair iteration
serve a selected iteration through a loopback-only review shell
summary: Create and inspect portable Session-1 projects, plus build, immutably repair, and loopback-preview exact detached static game candidates under zero candidate-process authority.
long_goal: Shapeable sandbox engine per AXM-SBX master route. Every session must leave declared seats (bodies, cores, migration) open rather than hardcoding today's tech into the spine.
